title: PlayStation Offers $40 Off PS5 Refurb Bundles Ahead of GTA 6
description: PlayStation is offering a $40 discount on refurbished PS5 and DualSense controller bundles, giving players a chance to save up to $155 ahead of GTA 6.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## PlayStation Rolls Out PS5 Refurbished Bundle Discounts Ahead of GTA 6

As the gaming community eagerly counts down toward the launch of *GTA 6*, hardware preparation has become a major talking point for players looking to experience the massive open-world title in the best possible way. According to a recent report by IGN, PlayStation is currently offering a hardware promotion that slashes prices on bundles for players looking to upgrade.

Specifically, PlayStation is offering a $40 discount when customers purchase a refurbished PlayStation 5 console and a DualSense wireless controller together. When factoring in the baseline price difference between new and refurbished units, this promotion delivers up to $155 in total savings for buyers.

### A Cost-Effective Path to Next-Gen

For gamers still playing on previous-generation hardware like the PS4, transitioning to a next-gen console is practically essential for handling the dense environments, advanced physics, and detailed graphics expected in *GTA 6*. However, the cost of brand-new gaming hardware can sometimes be a barrier to entry.

Official refurbished hardware offers a reliable alternative, providing the performance of a PS5 with official backing while significantly cutting down costs. Paired with a DualSense controller in this bundle, players get an immediate setup ready for next-gen gaming without paying full retail price.

### Market Context and Strategic Timing

While the hardware discount serves as a general consumer promotion, the timing aligns closely with the industry-wide anticipation surrounding *GTA 6*. Major software blockbusters of this magnitude historically drive a significant spike in console sales. Industry observers note that hardware manufacturers often use pre-launch windows to capture cost-conscious consumers who want to upgrade their systems before the biggest titles hit the market.

## Editor's Take

Preparing your gaming setup for *GTA 6* doesn't necessarily mean breaking the bank. PlayStation's $40 discount on refurbished PS5 and controller bundles—totaling up to $155 in savings—provides a smart, budget-friendly option for players transitioning from older systems. With official backing on the refurbished hardware, it's a solid opportunity to gear up ahead of time.
